startUrls.description: Add Tweet, profile, search, or List URLs as strings or {"url":"..."} objects. Profile URLs may use /with_replies, /media, or best-effort /likes. Example: ["https://x.com/elonmusk", "https://x.com/sear

twitterContent.description: Search query using X advanced search syntax. Supports keywords, hashtags, exact phrases, boolean operators, and date or Unix time windows. Every returned tweet falls inside your dates. Example: web sc

searchTerms.description: Run multiple searches in one Actor run. Max Items applies across the run. Every result matches the date and Unix time operators in its term. Example: from:elonmusk AI, #bitcoin lang:en

twitterHandles.description: X usernames whose posts to collect. Profile Tweets matches the Posts tab on X: posts, reposts & the author's replies to their own posts. Add Exclude replies under Tweet type filters for original posts

profileUrls.description: Alias for Start URLs. Add profile URL strings or {"url":"..."} objects.

tweetIds.description: Tweet IDs to look up directly. Other sources in the same input run too, and Max Items applies across the run. Process up to 10,000 tweet IDs per run. Example: 1846987139428634858

listIds.description: X List IDs whose posts to collect. It is usually much faster than List URLs or the List ID filter below. Example: 1748648376080666720

mode.description: Auto picks a mode from your input. Choose a mode to force one. Profile Tweets matches the Posts tab on X: posts, reposts & the author's replies to their own posts. Profile With Replies keeps target-au

maxItems.description: Optional result cap across the whole run. Leave empty to use your Apify max total charge as the result limit when set. Without a spend cap, Xquik uses its built-in default. The Apify pricing box shows

maxItemsPerTarget.description: Optional cap for each target in multi-target modes.

queryType.description: Latest returns newest first. Top is ranked by relevance and is not exhaustive. Latest + Top returns both without duplicates and fills your limit from either. Account timelines ignore this setting.

content.description: Build content filters without writing X search syntax.

users.description: Optional structured author, reply, mention, and list filters.

time.description: Keep posts from a date window. Use dates, Unix times, a recent window such as 2d, or post IDs.

lang.description: Filter tweets by language using a 2-letter ISO 639-1 code. Every returned tweet matches this language.

tweetTypes.description: Optional tweet type filters. Include only one type, or exclude replies, reposts or quote tweets.

conversation_id.description: Only include tweets belonging to this conversation thread. Use the first tweet's ID in the thread.

conversationIds.description: Alias for one or more conversation_id searches.

quoted_tweet_id.description: Only include tweets that quote this specific tweet ID.

quoted_user_id.description: Only include tweets that quote any tweet from this user ID.

filter:has_engagement.description: Only include tweets with at least one like, retweet, or reply.

include:nativeretweets.description: Include native retweets in results (excluded by default).

filter:twimg.description: Only include tweets containing twimg.com images.

filter:native_video.description: Only include tweets with natively uploaded video.

filter:vine.description: X no longer supports this filter. A search with it ends with a free diagnostic.

filter:consumer_video.description: X no longer supports this filter. A search with it ends with a free diagnostic.

filter:pro_video.description: X no longer supports this filter. A search with it ends with a free diagnostic.

filter:spaces.description: Only include tweets containing a Spaces link.

outputVariant.description: Legacy preserves compatibility. Rich adds normalized public fields. Raw snapshot also adds a sanitized source snapshot. Compact and Full are Legacy aliases.

fieldStyle.description: Controls top-level and nested field names for rich and raw results, including reply diagnostics. Use camelCase for JavaScript and TypeScript. Use snake_case for Python, SQL, CSV, and warehouses. Legac

outputPreset.description: Nested preserves the current object shape. Flat + nested also adds CSV-friendly author and media URL fields.

includeSearchTerms.description: Attach the first matching search term as `searchTerm` on each unique Tweet. Use it to identify which query produced each deduplicated result.

respectProfileSubpages.description: Honor profile subpage paths such as /with_replies, /media, and /likes in profile URLs. /with_replies returns target-authored posts and replies. The Actor excludes conversation context from other autho

articleTweetIds.description: Tweet IDs to read with mode article.

replyTweetIds.description: Tweet IDs whose direct replies to collect. Nested replies never count as direct. If replies look incomplete, the Actor adds a diagnostic when your limit allows. Real replies always come first.

quoteTweetIds.description: Tweet IDs to read with mode quotes.

threadTweetIds.description: Tweet IDs to read with mode thread.

retweeterTweetIds.description: Tweet IDs to read with mode retweeters.

favoriterTweetIds.description: Tweet IDs to read with mode favoriters. X may only expose liking users for eligible or owner-visible posts. If no users are available, the actor returns one diagnostic row.

from.description: Only include tweets sent by this username (without the @ symbol). Example: elonmusk

to.description: Only include tweets that are replies to this username (without @). Example: OpenAI

@.description: Only include tweets that mention this username (without @). Example: Google

since.description: Keep posts from this date onward. The Actor checks each post's date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS_UTC. Example: 2026-01-01_00:00:00_UTC

until.description: Keep posts from before this date. The Actor checks each post's date. Same format as Since date. Example: 2026-04-01_00:00:00_UTC

since_time.description: Keep posts from this Unix time onward, in seconds. The Actor checks each post's time. Example: 1704067200

until_time.description: Keep posts from before this Unix time, in seconds. The Actor checks each post's time. Example: 1711929600

within_time.description: Only include tweets from the last N days, hours, minutes or seconds. Put d, h, m or s after the number. Example: 12h

since_id.description: Only include tweets with an ID greater than (posted after) this tweet ID.

max_id.description: Only include tweets with an ID less than (posted before) this tweet ID.

min_faves.description: Only include tweets with at least this many likes. Set to 0 to disable.

-min_faves.description: Only include tweets with at most this many likes. Set to 0 to disable.

min_retweets.description: Only include tweets with at least this many retweets. Set to 0 to disable.

-min_retweets.description: Only include tweets with at most this many retweets. Set to 0 to disable.

min_replies.description: Only include tweets with at least this many replies. Set to 0 to disable.

-min_replies.description: Only include tweets with at most this many replies. Set to 0 to disable.

filter:blue_verified.description: Only include tweets from X Premium (Blue) verified accounts.

filter:media.description: Apply X's media search operator. Results usually include attached media, but X can also match media-like card content.

filter:images.description: Apply X's image search operator. Results usually include image media. X can also match card or link image content.

filter:videos.description: Apply X's video search operator. Results usually include native video media.

filter:links.description: Only include tweets containing external links.

filter:news.description: X no longer supports this filter. A search with it ends with a free diagnostic.

filter:safe.description: Only include tweets marked as safe (excludes sensitive content).

near.description: Only include tweets geotagged near this place. Example: San Francisco

within.description: Radius for the Near Place filter. Format: integer + unit (km or mi), no spaces. Example: 10km, 25mi

geocode.description: Filter by exact coordinates in lat,long,radius format. Use no spaces. Give the radius in km or mi. Example: 37.7749,-122.4194,10km

list.description: Filter search results to Tweets from members of this X List. Use List IDs unless you need to combine this filter with other search operators.

url.description: Only include tweets containing this URL or domain. Example: github.com

card_name.description: Filter by poll or card type. Common values: poll2choice_text_only, poll3choice_text_only, poll4choice_text_only, poll2choice_image, poll3choice_image, poll4choice_image.

alwaysSaveRunRecords.description: Save run-report on every run. When off, small runs that go well skip it & cost less.

includeRaw.description: API alias for Output Variant raw.

includeArticles.description: Deprecated compatibility input. Article data is already included when X provides it.

includeUnavailableFields.description: Deprecated compatibility input. Safe availability fields are already included when X provides them.

includeOriginalTweet.description: Deprecated compatibility input. Look up source tweets separately with Tweet IDs.
